name: CYMOR ASSISTANT
description: Personal WhatsApp AI receptionist with an admin dashboard. Powered by CYMOR TECH SERVICES.

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB Atlas connection string (include the database name, e.g. .../cymor-assistant?retryWrites=true&w=majority).

OWNER_PHONE_NUMBER.description: Owner's WhatsApp number in international format, digits only (e.g. 2547XXXXXXXX).

SESSION_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Encrypts the stored WhatsApp session. BACK THIS UP: losing it forces a new QR scan.

DASHBOARD_PASSWORD_HASH.description: bcrypt hash of the dashboard password (npm run hash -- "your password").

ASSISTANT_ENABLED.description: Initial state of the assistant (switchable later in the dashboard).
